title: tracks_m.jsonl — one JSON object per line, per track per frame
description: AMENDMENT A1. Ground-plane projection of tracks_px.jsonl. Produced by M1's projection stage (owner B). Consumed by M3, and by C for M5 norms and M10 baseline.

ground_m.description: [x, y] metres. Origin at the first calibration reference point, X east, Y north, right-handed. Projected from the BOTTOM-CENTRE of the bbox, never the centroid.

v_mps.description: [vx, vy] metres per second, from a least-squares fit over a sliding window. Never raw frame-to-frame differencing.

speed_kmh.description: Derived from v_mps at serialisation only. All internal computation is SI.

heading_deg.description: Compass-style bearing of v_mps, 0 = +Y (north), increasing clockwise. Range [0, 360).
